items.title: Parkour – L’art de repousser ses limites
items.author: Josephine Dao Devenyns
items.excerpt: À l’âge de 10 ans, Jérémy Gagnon découvre le parkour dans une vidéo de l’acrobate Damien Walters et sait immédiatement qu’il veut en faire sa discipline. Aujourd’hui entraîneur à l’ACTN3 – Ninja Warrior & Parkour à Montréal, il enchaîne les figures acrobatiques en toute
items.leadExcerpt: À l’âge de 10 ans, Jérémy Gagnon découvre le parkour dans une vidéo de l’acrobate Damien Walters et sait immédiatement qu’il veut en faire sa discipline. Aujourd’hui entraîneur à l’ACTN3 – Ninja Warrior & Parkour à Montréal, il enchaîne les figures acrobatiques en toute tranquillité. Derrière ce calme se cache pourtant une pratique où chaque mouvement doit être maîtrisé, afin d’éviter la moindre erreur. Quelques minutes avant l’ouverture d’ACTN3, à Montréal, la salle est encore silencieuse. Les tapis sont immobiles, les barres attendent les premier·ère·s pratiquant·e·s. Jérémy Gagnon, 25 ans, est déjà là. Calme et discret, il est loin de l’image spectaculaire que peut renvoyer le parkour.

items.title: Three arrested at anti-austerity student protest
items.author: Léo Vallet David
items.excerpt: Thousands of students protested on Friday over their discontent with austerity measures, eventually leading to three arrests and clashes with the police.
items.leadExcerpt: On Friday, Nov. 13, thousands of students rallied at Square-Victoria around 2 p.m. to protest austerity measures imposed on the province’s CEGEPs and universities. The crowd was estimated at between 75,000 and 100,000 people, according to reports from both La Presse and Radio-Canada. The SPVM did not calculate the exact number of protesters. The protest ended at around 5 p.m. with three arrests and eight mischiefs — a legal term describing property damage or destruction, property rendered dangerous, useless, inoperative or ineffective, obstructed, or interrupting or interfering with its lawful use — confirmed by the Montreal police (SPVM).

items.title: More than half of Quebecers are unsatisfied with Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, according to recent poll
items.author: Léo Vallet David
items.excerpt: A recent Pallas Data poll puts St-Pierre Plamondon’s approval rating at 23 per cent, an unwelcome sign for a newly elected minority government
items.leadExcerpt: The results are even worse on the Island of Montreal, where the Parti Québécois (PQ) won two seats — including St-Pierre Plamondon’s. Only 14 per cent of of respondents were satisfied with his government, compared to 62 per cent who were not. In the greater Montreal area — which encompasses Laval, the north and south shores — that number goes down to 50 per cent saying they’re unsatisfied with the performance so far and 26 per cent said they’re satisfied. On Oct. 5, the PQ carried 26 ridings in both the north and south shores.

items.title: Rencontre Carney-PSPP au Cambodge
items.author: Médéric Dens
items.excerpt: Québec, Montréal ou Ottawa ? C’est finalement au Cambodge que le premier ministre canadien et le premier ministre québécois se sont rencontrés pour la première fois depuis les dernières élections provinciales, dans le cadre de l’Organisation internationale de la Francophonie.
items.sourceImageCredit: Photo : Page Facebook de Mark Carney
items.leadExcerpt: Québec, Montréal ou Ottawa ? C’est finalement au Cambodge que le premier ministre canadien et le premier ministre québécois se sont rencontrés pour la première fois depuis les dernières élections provinciales, dans le cadre de l’Organisation internationale de la Francophonie. Après la tourmente entourant la présence, ou non, du premier ministre provincial au sommet Canada-Union européenne qui s’est récemment tenu à Montréal, la seconde chicane concernait le lieu choisi pour la première rencontre entre Paul St-Pierre Plamondon (PSPP) et le premier ministre fédéral.

items.title: Abolir ou réformer Santé Québec ?
items.author: Médéric Dens
items.excerpt: Deux ans après la création de Santé Québec, quoi garder et quoi réformer ? Ce qui s’annonçait comme un projet mettant à l’avant-plan l’efficience, semble pourtant ajouter un poids sur la bureaucratie dans un ministère déjà alourdi.
items.leadExcerpt: Deux ans après la création de Santé Québec, quoi garder et quoi réformer ? Ce qui s’annonçait comme un projet mettant à l’avant-plan l’efficience, semble pourtant ajouter un poids sur la bureaucratie dans un ministère déjà alourdi. Le premier ministre du Québec, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, avait promis d’abolir Santé Québec lors de la plus récente campagne. Ce dernier semble pourtant se rétracter et parle désormais d’une « réforme », en ne conservant que les éléments fonctionnels.

items.title: Canada in Media: A Belated Review of Sterling Point
items.author: Olivia Epstein
items.excerpt: As we enter November, I am confident that many McGillians share the dread I feel, knowing that the days of sitting on Lower Field with only a light sweater are behind us. As a Canadian, I don’t believe I will ever fully acclimatise to this weather, even two decades in. Facing
items.leadExcerpt: As we enter November, I am confident that many McGillians share the dread I feel, knowing that the days of sitting on Lower Field with only a light sweater are behind us. As a Canadian, I don’t believe I will ever fully acclimatise to this weather, even two decades in. Facing this impending drop in temperature and the relegation of warm weather to the realm of the fever dream, I decided a rewatch of Sterling Point (2026) was in order. How better to hold onto Canada’s summers than by climbing right back into that environment, letting this well-made, sunny, coming-of-age show take over my screen once again?

items.title: How a student-led movement prevailed in Serbia’s election
items.author: Léo Vallet David
items.excerpt: After months of protests and years of frustration, Serbian students have prevailed, electing 140 pro-student candidates to the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia on Oct. 25.
items.leadExcerpt: The newly created Student List (SL) party won 140 seats, while President Aleksandar Vučić’s United Serbia party won 103, giving the SL a majority of 30 seats in Serbia’s parliament. This shift in Serbian politics marks a new era, with young protesters having led the charge to remove Aleksandar Vučić from power. Vučić, who was Serbia’s prime minister from 2014 to 2017, was first elected president in 2017 with 56 per cent of the votes. He won the presidential election again in 2022, though his party narrowly lost its majority in parliament, which it won back in 2023.

items.title: Why young people should watch more films like Persepolis
items.author: Chloé Etienne
items.excerpt: As a Concordia student minoring in film studies, I am fortunate to have access to a wide range of films that enrich and educate me on a daily basis. During my film history class this week, I had the chance to watch Persepolis, a French animated film adapted from the
items.leadExcerpt: As a Concordia student minoring in film studies, I am fortunate to have access to a wide range of films that enrich and educate me on a daily basis. During my film history class this week, I had the chance to watch Persepolis, a French animated film adapted from the autobiographical graphic novel by Marjane Satrapi, a Franco-Iranian artist. Directed by Satrapi herself and Vincent Paronnaud, Persepolis explores Marjane’s childhood in Tehran, which is marked by the 1979 Islamic Revolution, the mullahs’ regime, the oppression suffered by women and the Iran-Iraq War. But beyond political and social issues, the film portrays resilience and the determination to push through and fight for one’s rights.

items.title: Peut-on encore posséder de la culture ?
items.author: Maxence Gibault-Renault
items.excerpt: GTA VI sera bien vendu en version physique, mais sans disque, avec simplement un code de téléchargement dans la jaquette. (Photo : Maxence Gibault-Renault) Tous les pans de l’industrie culturelle sont concernés. La digitalisation conduit les éditeurs à se passer des supports
items.leadExcerpt: Tous les pans de l’industrie culturelle sont concernés. La digitalisation conduit les éditeurs à se passer des supports physiques, parfois au détriment de l’utilisateur, contraint de ne plus posséder. « On a commencé à observer cela au début des années 2000 avec la création d’iTunes par Apple. Avant même les plateformes de visionnement en ligne, on vendait des chansons, mais les conditions d’utilisation précisaient déjà qu’il s’agissait d’une permission d’utilisation, et non d’une vente équivalente à celle d’un produit physique », explique Guy-Philippe Wells, chercheur au Laboratoire de recherche sur la découvrabilité et les transformations des industries culturelles à l’ère du commerce électronique de l’UQAM.

items.title: The kids are not alright: the youth unemployment problem in Canada
items.author: Kasi Peri
items.excerpt: According to the 2026 federal budget, Canada’s youth unemployment rate has hit 13.7 per cent this year. As unemployment numbers continue to increase for this age group, university and government programs have stepped in to try and address the problem.
items.leadExcerpt: According to the 2026 federal budget, Canada’s youth unemployment rate has hit 13.7 per cent this year. As unemployment numbers continue to increase for this age group, university and government programs have stepped in to try and address the problem. Statistics Canada’s Daily Labour Survey found that youth unemployment, which measures people aged 15–29, “rose 0.7 percentage points to 13.7% in October.” A TD Economics study also noted that unemployment for teenagers had increased. Unemployment rates for this particular age group are affected by limited job availability, especially in service industries, and the pandemic, according to data collected.

items.title: QUICKSPIN: Lil Baby — FRESH
items.author: Aidan Flanagan
items.excerpt: Lil Baby has been a household name in the hip-hop genre since 2018, largely thanks to his breakout hit “Yes Indeed.” Gone, however, are the days when a Lil Baby verse was a coveted commodity.
items.leadExcerpt: Lil Baby’s studio albums have failed to garner much attention, and it has never been clearer than on his latest record. FRESH is far from an apt title, as not a single track on this record feels fresh by any means. The intro track, “Top Uh It,” begins so abruptly that it feels as though the album began right in the middle of its own runtime, with the rapper seeming almost unable to keep up with the instrumental. The lyrics are about exactly what every other Lil Baby song has ever been about: money, cars and clothes.

items.title: QUICKSPIN: Dove Cameron — FINAL GIRL
items.author: Julia Imee Silva
items.excerpt: Dove Cameron’s second studio album, FINAL GIRL, is her most confessional record yet. Vulnerability takes the stage in multiple forms as she explores the different makeups of the cinematic final girl — the one who conquers despite the mess.
items.leadExcerpt: Dove Cameron’s second studio album, FINAL GIRL, is her most confessional record yet. Vulnerability takes the stage in multiple forms as she explores the different makeups of the cinematic final girl — the one who conquers despite the mess. Cameron opens with “silver screen baby,” a soft ballad exposing a desperation to leave the Hollywood spotlight behind. The piano and strings create an atmosphere that drags listeners into the same emotionality whirling in her heart.

items.title: Bishop’s and Queen’s Launch New Business Master’s Pathway
items.author: Addison Walker
items.excerpt: Good news for Bishop’s they now have three new master’s programs to consider. Bishop’s University has partnered with the Smith School of Business at Queen’s University to provide eligible Williams School of Business students with a faster pathway into post-grad study. This
items.leadExcerpt: Good news for Bishop’s they now have three new master’s programs to consider. Bishop’s University has partnered with the Smith School of Business at Queen’s University to provide eligible Williams School of Business students with a faster pathway into post-grad study. This provides students with three different pathways into the International Business (Kingston), Management Analytics (Toronto), and Finance (Beijing) programs. Applicants can be nominated by Bishop’s in their final year of study. A nomination ensures that applicants won’t have to pay any fees and will be guaranteed an interview regarding the program and their future goals with a member of the Smith program team. You must still meet the requirements for your chosen degree, but you’ll receive $5,000 off your tuition.

items.leadExcerpt: The colour of the day at the Hindu Mission of Canada’s Montreal temple is a bright, almost neon orange. The Murti, icon statues of Hindu deities, are dressed in elaborate orange clothing with gold and green trim. items.leadExcerpt: Soprano Caroline Gélinas performed in Bandeen Hall as part of the Music Chez Nous program, a concert series which facilitates musical performances at the University. The concert was free for students (as all Music Chez Nous concerts are) and cost thirty dollars for community members. Gélinas, who studied at the Montreal Conservatory of Music, is an acclaimed vocalist who, only a few days before the concert, placed third in the Johannes Brahms Society International Competition in Austria, also receiving a Special Prize for the best interpretation of a work by the composer Rainer Bischof. She was the only female artist and the only non-Germanophobe to proceed to the finale.

items.title: Mid-Semester Reset with BUO
items.author: Grace Mackay
items.excerpt: As we approach the middle of the semester, students are feeling the pressure of exams, papers, readings, assignments and so much more. You likely find yourself trapped in the library for hours on end, staring at screens and attempting to dwindle down the long lists of
items.leadExcerpt: As we approach the middle of the semester, students are feeling the pressure of exams, papers, readings, assignments and so much more. You likely find yourself trapped in the library for hours on end, staring at screens and attempting to dwindle down the long lists of mid-semester tasks. As important as it is to apply yourself, expand your mind and focus on studies, it is necessary to find a healthy balance. But how do you find balance when all you can focus on is the laundry list of tasks to complete? The answer is simpler than we make it out to be. Give some time back to yourself and take a break.
